summary.name: Mp3tag
summary.one_liner: Mp3tag is a Mac tag editor for batch-editing metadata and cover art across many audio and video formats.
use_cases: Batch-editing tags for a whole music library
Downloading cover art and metadata from Discogs or MusicBrainz
Renaming audio files based on their tag information
Resizing or converting embedded cover art
Automating repetitive tag clean-up with action groups
Organizing DJ or podcast audio files
summary.what_it_does: Mp3tag edits metadata and embedded cover art for audio files, supporting batch editing of multiple files at once. Supported formats named on the page include MP3, MP4, M4V, MKV, FLAC, OGG, OPUS, AIF, DSF, MPC, WV and WAV. It can look up tags and cover art from the Discogs and MusicBrainz online databases. It can rename files from tag data, replace characters or words in tags and filenames, import tag information, and adjust the size and image format of cover art. Repeated tasks can be combined into action groups that act as workflows, for example case conversion or removing unwanted fields.
notable: Batch tag editing across many audio and video formats
Online lookups from Discogs and MusicBrainz
Action groups for repeatable tag and cover art workflows
Renaming files and replacing text in tags and filenames
caveats: Paid app; a 7-day free trial is offered
Page names only the Mac version; no other platforms are listed
Page text is largely promotional, so feature details are limited
